description: Diagnostic-only module targeting rug_pull_monitor heartbeat recovery. Queries write_service for service_health rows where service='rug_pull_monitor' and last_heartbeat > 600h (threshold per spec section 6). Reads rug_pull_monitor.py source to identify why heartbeat stopped. Checks PID file presence, supervisord status via /tmp directory, and whether the process is alive but not calling heartbeat. Produces a structured report: process_status (alive/dead/missing_pid), heartbeat_age_seconds, pid_file_present, last_import_error (if any from logs), and recommended_action (restart needed / configuration fix / dependency issue). Does NOT attempt to restart the daemon.rug_pull_monitor is protected; this file only generates diagnostic output.
